notes: Strip e: x 7120-8870 plus ~300 px overlap (6820-9170). Walter Avenue (centre x~6720) lies outside the overlap and is left to strip d. Top street: ROSS printed at x~3800 and AVENUE at x~8800 on one continuous line, called Ross Avenue; it jogs ~175 px north across Montgomery Pike into Buxton Avenue (address series continues). Montgomery: printed MONTGOMERY ... PIKE north of the railroads (Highland to the Carthage merge) and AVE. (x~8370,y~2730) ... MONTGOMERY (x~7400,y~4900) south of them; recorded as Montgomery Pike for y<2100 and Montgomery Avenue for y>2100, same road (rename if you want one name). Carthage and Montgomery Pike merge over y~1440-1800; south of the merge the roadway follows Carthage's line and Smith Road continues that line south of the railroads while Montgomery veers SSW. Norwood Avenue, Sherman Avenue and Washington Avenue each jog across Montgomery/Lafayette (two T's each). Station Avenue jogs ~170 px across Elm (printed AVE. north of Maple, STATION south). Judge Avenue printed AVE. on its N-S leg and JUDGE on its SSW leg. Crown printed CROWN (x~6400) and ST. (x~7380). Lafayette Avenue is taken as the ~50 ft street SE of the C&N Railway tracks (centreline x+y~13612); the railway runs alongside. Unnamed 16 ft alley behind Montgomery Pike lots from Highland to Norwood Avenue (Malcolm Avenue ends at it). Railroads, the GLOBE siding through the Wernicke works, the subdivision boundary lines (cyan/orange) and the big spaced subdivision names (ROOS, STEWART'S, LANGDON'S, KAHLE'S, HOPKINS etc.) are not streets.
